author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Grounded PBR props and instanced scatter
description: Load pinned static GLBs, normalize ground-centered pivots and meter heights without changing source geometry or PBR maps. Clone placements and instanced scatter; register procedural prototypes. Shared resource cleanup and explicit circle collision output. Animated/skinned instancing excluded.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Manage reusable model prototypes and efficient world placement.

exports.name: fitModel
exports.does: Wrap a static model at ground origin and scale to the desired meter height.

options.name: heightAt
options.does: Terrain elevation for placements without explicit y.

hooks.name: onProgress
hooks.does: Report a loaded prototype for progress UI.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Terrain walker with sliding disk collisions
description: Camera-relative movement from an injected fps-controls handle, terrain following, step bob, optional sprint, circular obstacle sliding and bounded substeps to avoid tunneling. Static horizontal disk collision; no general rigidbody physics.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Move a camera through a sampled 3D world.

exports.name: moveDisk
exports.does: Advance with circle collisions, bounds and axis sliding.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Exploration supplies, generator and radio signal rules
description: Renderer-free proximity-checked collection, fuel/fuse power prerequisites, survey-log requirement, carrier-frequency tuning, signal meter, explicit transmission, reset and victory events. No timer, combat or persistence. Optional openPlay mode removes prerequisites and victory, with reversible generator and ungated radio experimentation.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Compose a small restoration expedition from site records.

options.name: sites
options.does: World positions, item identities and prompt text.

options.name: openPlay
options.does: Use reversible toys without collection requirements or an ending.

hooks.name: onEvent
hooks.does: Observe accepted and rejected actions for UI/audio.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Forest ambience and spatial machinery sound
description: Sample-free Web Audio wind, intermittent bird chirps, footsteps, confirmation chime and HRTF generator hum. Lazy user-gesture creation, volume control, pause/resume and disposal. Includes distinct bell tones and a tunable radio carrier.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Create a generated woodland soundscape with listener-relative machine audio.

hooks.name: onStart
hooks.does: Observe creation of the sound engine.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Stillwater: trails, caches and station layout
description: Editable seeded woodland expedition layout: 96m playable region, terrain spawn, three supply trails, five sites and radio carrier frequency. Companion world data for signal-trail and Stillwater Field Station.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Stillwater: immersive world composition guide
description: Reusable asset and logic inventory, controls, PBR/world conventions, source provenance and remix instructions for a small exploration playground. Optional generator, radio and stone/bell toys; no required objective.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Green pine branch spray · original CC0
description: Original transparent 512px RGBA pine-needle branch card with no snow. sRGB, alpha-test at 0.45, double-sided. Seeded procedural synthesis with scripts/make-field-pine.mjs; no photographic inputs. Pair with northwoods-trees at snow:0.

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Stones and resonant targets · small 3D play toy
description: Renderer-free ballistic throws with bounded substeps, configurable gravity and launch speed, sampled-ground bounces, spherical target hits and bounded projectile lifetime/count. Hook target hits to sounds, scores and physical feedback. No victory state or mandatory objective.

exports.name: attach
exports.does: Simulate a bounded stone-toss toy with target events.

options.name: targets
options.does: World x/y/z positions, radius and caller-defined metadata.

hooks.name: onHit
hooks.does: Trigger sound and animation for a target hit.
